title: Claim Ledger
description: Maps factual and legal claims to supporting evidence within the evidence-first litigation workflow. Claims without supported status must not appear in external submissions.

ledger_version.description: Semantic version of this ledger document (e.g., '1', '2').

generated.description: ISO 8601 date when this ledger snapshot was generated.

case_id.description: Parent case identifier — must match the ledger's case_id.

claim_statement.description: A single, unambiguous factual or legal assertion.

claim_category.description: Category of the claim: fact = factual assertion; legal_conclusion = legal inference; calculation = numeric/financial; timeline_event = event that occurred at a specific time.

supporting_evidence_ids.description: EV-{ID} items that support this claim. Empty array means the claim is currently unsupported.

support_status.description: supported = claim is fully established by authenticated evidence; partially_supported = evidence exists but is incomplete or unauthenticated; unsupported = no supporting evidence exists.

support_notes.description: Explanation of the current support status assignment.

missing_evidence.description: Description of evidence items needed to promote this claim's support status.

evidence_request_ids.description: REQ-{ID} entries in the evidence request register for outstanding items needed by this claim.

added_date.description: ISO 8601 date when this claim was first added to the ledger.

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 date of the last status update to this claim.
